summary: The second session of Politecnico di Torino's call for its 42nd cycle of PhD programmes in engineering, architecture and related fields, in Torino, Italy. Applications open on 15 October 2026 for programmes starting on 1 March 2027. The call offers a minimum of 110 positions with scholarships across three sessions.
highlights: For PhD applicants in engineering, architecture and related PhD programmes.
A minimum of 110 positions with scholarships across the call's three sessions.
